capabilities: Assign a template note to a base view via a command
Create new notes from the assigned template via the base's New button
Merge template properties with values the base's filters require
Fill {{date}}, {{time}} and Templater placeholders in new notes
Resolve the template for bases embedded with ![[Name.base]]
disambiguation: Not a collection of template files; it wires a base's New button to any template note you pick.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Code-block bases written directly into notes get no template, since they have no file to configure.
intentEvidence: This is the behaviour asked for in the forum thread Bases: New With Template (for 'New' Button).
problem: In Obsidian's Bases, the New button always creates a blank note, with no way to base it on a template.

relations.evidence: If the template uses Templater (<% ... %>) and Templater is installed, Templater fills it in
Views made by the Split Groups plugin are left alone, since Split Groups sets its own template per view.

summary: Bases companion that makes the New button in a base view create a note from a template you choose per base or per view.
